info.name: Cloudtruck API (v1)
info.description:
Postman collection generated from backend route + validator definitions. Base path: /api/v1.

Notes:
- Collection auth uses Bearer {{accessToken}}. Login requests save access/refresh tokens into collection variables.
- Some payment endpoints have code/validator param-name mismatches; those requests are included but may return 400 until the backend is aligned.

{
  "category": "payment-issue",
  "subject": "Payment not reflected for Booking #12345",
  "description": "I have made the payment via UPI but the status is still showing as pending. Please verify.",
  "priority": "medium",
  "bookingId": "<OPTIONAL_BOOKING_ID>"
}
